data.title: Lemon garlic pasta
data.description: Silky, bright, and ready before the table is set.

steps.title: Boil the pasta
steps.text: Cook the pasta in well-salted water until just al dente.

steps.title: Sizzle the garlic
steps.text: Gently sizzle the garlic in olive oil until fragrant.

steps.title: Build the sauce
steps.text: Add pasta, lemon zest, juice, and a splash of pasta water.

steps.title: Finish and serve
steps.text: Toss with parmesan until glossy. Season and serve.

data.title: Slow-roasted tomatoes with whipped ricotta and toasted sourdough
data.description: Prepare the ingredients, then follow each step at your own pace.

ingredients.text: 500g mixed tomatoes, halved lengthways, with all their juices reserved for serving

steps.title: Roast the tomatoes
steps.text: Spread the tomatoes in a single layer. Turn halfway through cooking, then keep roasting until the edges soften and the juices thicken. Rest before spooning over the ricotta.

steps.title: Assemble and serve
steps.text: Spoon the ricotta onto toast and top with the warm tomatoes and their juices.
